notes.subject: fix(cli): stop prompting for user-configured MCP servers at turn start
notes.summary: The CLI no longer prompts for approval of user-configured MCP servers at turn start, and their startup connections run in the background so the first turn isn't blocked; project-sourced servers still prompt.
